show tuesday
scene sanatochika1
It isn’t often that I wake up in unfamiliar rooms, but it is often that I feel out of place.
lines.zh: 我在陌生的房间里醒来并不常见，但我经常感到格格不入。

lines.en: This is strange on one hand, and all too common on the other.
lines.zh: 这从一方面说很奇怪，从另一方面说又太常见了。

lines.en: And as I lie here in bed with a girl half my size and half my age, I come to terms with the fact that I have never been pure.
lines.zh: 而当我躺在床上，身边是一个只有我一半体型、一半年龄的女孩时，我承认了一个事实——我从未纯洁过。

lines.en: I was born just as everyone else — with original sin and a cord attached to my belly. But while one was severed and left to decay in a dumpster somewhere, the other sits with me to this day.
lines.zh: 我和所有人一样出生——带着原罪，和一根连在肚子上的脐带。但其中一个被剪断、丢在某个垃圾箱里腐烂，另一个至今还与我在了一起。

lines.en: It’s never bothered me before. Knowing I had never had a chance, I mean. Because, when it really comes down to it, there isn’t a single person on the face of this earth that’s truly pure.
lines.zh: 这之前从没困扰过我。我是说，我知道自己从来没有过机会。因为说到底，这世上没有一个人是真正纯洁的。

lines.en: I thought there was once.
lines.zh: 我曾以为有过。

lines.en: scene sanaisbetternow27
scene sanatochika1
But I was just deluding myself.
lines.zh: 但那只是我在欺骗自己。

lines.en: I latched onto something that felt impossible and out of reach. But in my head, it was more like I was latching onto the idea of holding something I knew I couldn’t have.
lines.zh: 我执着于某种遥不可及的东西。但在我脑子里，更像是我执着于「握住我明知得不到的东西」这个念头本身。

lines.en: scene sanatochika2
What I know now is that there is nothing I can not take.
lines.zh: 我现在知道的是：没有什么是我拿不到的。

lines.en: It’s that I should have taken something when I was told to.
lines.zh: 问题在于，我该在别人告诉我的时候就去拿的。

lines.en: Because if I had only listened to directions, the girl beside me might be different right now.
lines.zh: 因为只要我当时听从了指示，现在躺在我身边的女孩也许就不是她了。

lines.en: And while their sizes are similar, I can’t imagine one as the other even when I close my eyes.
lines.zh: 虽然她们体型相仿，但即使闭上眼，我也没法把这一个想象成另一个。

lines.en: I know this to be true, because I tried all throughout the night.
lines.zh: 我知道这是真的，因为我试了整整一夜。

lines.en: : Sana! Are you still asleep in there? It’s half-past nine already!
lines.zh: : Sana！你还在里面睡着吗？已经九点半了！

lines.en: : Sana, don’t you have school today? You’re gonna be late! You need to get up!
lines.zh: : Sana，你今天不上学吗？要迟到了！你得起啦！

lines.en: : Hah...Fine! You can stay home! But I have things to do, so I won’t be here to make you breakfast whenever you decide to get out of bed! Got it?!
lines.zh: : 哈……好吧！你可以待在家！不过我有事要做，所以你决定起床的时候，可没人给你做早餐！听清了吗？！

lines.en: : Ah, who am I kidding? It’s not like she can hear me.
lines.zh: : 啊，我骗谁呢。她又听不见我。

lines.en: Sara’s footsteps fade away, only to be replaced by the creaking of her stairway seconds later.
lines.zh: Sara 的脚步声渐渐远去，几秒后被她家楼梯的吱呀声取代。

lines.en: Part of me wished she would have opened the door. That she would have seen me here in bed beside her daughter, with nothing more than a thick blanket covering the two of us.
lines.zh: 我心底有一部分希望她打开了那扇门。希望她看见我躺在她女儿身边，我们俩只盖着一条厚毯子。

lines.en: But even this I get away with.
lines.zh: 但连这个我都躲过了。

lines.en: I’m practically invincible.
lines.zh: 我简直是无敌的。

lines.en: But only practically.
lines.zh: 但也只是「简直」而已。

lines.en: scene black
scene sanatochika3
: That’s not as many as I thought.
lines.zh: : 没我想的那么多。

lines.en: I wonder if Ami got any sleep last night.
lines.zh: 不知道 Ami 昨晚睡着没有。

lines.en: I can’t imagine she did. But the last call from her came in around 6:00 AM, so I guess it’s possible she finally crashed after being hysterical for so long.
lines.zh: 我想她是没睡。不过她最后一通电话是早上六点左右打来的，所以我想她歇斯底里那么久之后，可能终于睡着了。

lines.en: Or she’s dead.
lines.zh: 或者她死了。

lines.en: If that’s the case, I’ll probably just end it today as well.
lines.zh: 要真是那样，我大概今天也了结自己。

lines.en: I got to knock Sana off my bucket list, so at least I’d be going out with a bang. Just not literally as we didn’t have sex last night.
lines.zh: 我总算把 Sana 从遗愿清单上划掉了，所以至少我能轰轰烈烈地走。只是不是字面意义的「轰烈」，因为我们昨晚没做爱。

lines.en: It’ll happen soon, though.
lines.zh: 不过很快就有了。

lines.en: She’s the type who won’t ever say no.
lines.zh: 她是那种永远不会说不的人。

lines.en: scene black
: What am I doing?...
lines.zh: : 我在干什么？……

lines.en: The phone begins to vibrate once more.
lines.zh: 手机又开始震动。

lines.en: But it’s not who I expect it to be.
lines.zh: 但不是我以为的那个人。

lines.en: scene sanatochika4
: Hello?
: Hey! Are you just waking up now? You sound tired.
lines.zh: : 嘿！你刚睡醒吗？你声音听起来好累。

lines.en: : I had a long night.
lines.zh: : 我昨晚过得挺长的。

lines.en: : Because you were burying Ami’s body in a ditch somewhere? God, please tell me that’s it.
lines.zh: : 因为你刚在某条沟里埋了 Ami 的尸体？天哪，拜托告诉我就是这个原因。

lines.en: scene sanatochika5
: Something like that.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧。

lines.en: : Awesome! That means I might get to work a double today. You don’t mind staying a little longer, do you? Chinami’s super excited to see you.
lines.zh: : 太好了！那说明我今天可能能排个双班。你不介意多待会儿吧？Chinami 特别想见你。

lines.en: : Oh, right. Babysitting.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。带孩子。

lines.en: : Babysitting, indeed. I’ll send you the new address just as soon as I’m done with my makeup. Don’t worry about travel time, though. It’s waaaaay closer than my old place. Way nicer too. You’ll love it.
lines.zh: : 没错，带孩子。我化完妆就把新地址发给你。不过路上时间不用担心——比我以前那儿近————多了。也漂亮多了。你会喜欢的。

lines.en: : Can you come now? Should I make some coffee for you?
lines.zh: : 你现在能来吗？要不要我给你冲杯咖啡？

lines.en: : Sensei? You there? You didn’t fall back asleep, did you?
lines.zh: : Sensei？你在吗？你没又睡过去吧？

lines.en: : No, I’m here.
lines.zh: : 没，我在。

lines.en: : I can come now.
lines.zh: : 我现在就过去。

lines.en: : Great!
lines.zh: : 太好了！

lines.en: scene black
: Go ahead and get ready then. And, if you get here early enough, I might even have a little surprise in store for youuuuu~
lines.zh: : 那你快准备吧。而且，要是你到得够早，我说不定会给你一点小惊喜。

lines.en: : Is it sex?
lines.zh: : 是做爱吗？

lines.en: : Not this time, unfortunately. But God I wish it was. I’ve been literally dying without you.
lines.zh: : 可惜这次不是。但天知道我多想是。没有你我都快死了。

lines.en: : And between the two of us, I didn’t touch myself at all the whole time you were gone~
lines.zh: : 而且跟你就我们俩说——你走的这段时间我一次都没自己碰过自己～

lines.en: : Oh yeah?
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah...so you can bet I’ll be extra eager to ride your big, hard- PANCAKES!
lines.zh: : 对……所以你尽管放心，我会格外渴望骑上你那根又大又硬的——薄煎饼！

lines.en: : ...My what?
lines.zh: : ……我的什么？

lines.en: : Sorry! Gotta go! Chinami’s breakfast is burning!
lines.zh: : 抱歉！先挂了！Chinami 的早餐要糊了！

lines.en: scene black
Chika hangs up the phone and sends me her new address a few minutes later.
lines.zh: Chika 挂了电话，几分钟后把新地址发了过来。

lines.en: As expected given the Tsukiokas’ ability to “make things happen,” she’s in the same building as me.
lines.zh: 以 Tsukioka 家「心想事成」的本事，不出所料，她跟我住进了同一栋楼。

lines.en: But thankfully, she’s on a different floor. So at least I’ll have that layer of privacy in...a building I barely spend any time in to begin with.
lines.zh: 不过好在她在另一层。所以至少我还有这么一层隐私……呃。

lines.en: But...maybe that will change.
lines.zh: 不过……也许以后会变的。

lines.en: Ami doesn’t know about it yet, so I could always disappear there if I need to get away from-
lines.zh: Ami 还不知道这事，所以我要是想躲开她，随时能躲到那儿去——

lines.en: No. No, I shouldn’t think that. I don’t need to get away from her. I love her. And right now, she needs me.
lines.zh: 不。不，我不该这么想。我不需要躲开她。我爱她。而现在，她……

lines.en: Right now, she’s hurting and...
lines.zh: 现在，她正在痛苦中，而且……

lines.en: And...
lines.zh: 而且……

lines.en: I put my clothes back on...and cover the rest of Sana’s body with the blanket.
lines.zh: 我穿回衣服……又用毯子把 Sana 身体的其余部分盖好。

lines.en: She doesn’t move a muscle.
lines.zh: 她一动不动。

lines.en: But when she finally wakes up, I hope she thinks of me.
lines.zh: 不过等她终于醒来，我希望她会想起我。

lines.en: scene black
And our house inside of my head.
lines.zh: 还有我脑子里那座我们俩的房子。

lines.en: scene sky
I make it there by 10:30, but I’m surprised to find a completely empty parking lot without a single moving truck in sight.
lines.zh: 我十点半到了那儿，却惊讶地发现停车场空空荡荡，一辆车都没有。

lines.en: Maybe Chika’s the first one to move in apart from me? I still have no idea what Touka’s plan is- or was, considering that she likely didn’t stop just because I was bedridden.
lines.zh: 也许除了我，Chika 是第一个搬进来的？我还是搞不懂 Touka 到底打的什么算盘。

lines.en: I wonder how she’s doing.
lines.zh: 不知道她现在怎么样了。

lines.en: And I wonder how she felt about my last ditch effort to regain some sanity by leaning on her during the Halloween party.
lines.zh: 也不知道她对我最后那次孤注一掷、靠着她来找回一点理智的举动作何感想。

lines.en: I hope she didn’t mind.
lines.zh: 希望她没介意。

lines.en: If only I was brave enough to ask her.
lines.zh: 要是我有勇气开口问她就好了。

lines.en: scene sanatochika6
: Well, look who it is! And without his mosquito of a niece buzzing around him this time!
lines.zh: : 哟，看看这是谁！这回没有他那蚊子一样的侄女围着他嗡嗡转了！

lines.en: : Hey...and...Touka’s here too, I see.
lines.zh: : 嘿……还有……Touka 也在，看来。

lines.en: : And Chinami! Hi, Papa! Chinami missed you lots and hopes you’re feeling better now!
lines.zh: : 还有 Chinami！嗨，爸爸！Chinami 好想你，希望你现在好些了！

lines.en: : Good morning, Sensei. I was just explaining some things about the apartment complex to Chika as I’m the new owner of this building and will be renting out several units to low-income families.
lines.zh: : 早上好，Sensei。我刚才正在向 Chika 和 Chinami 讲解这栋公寓的一些情况。

lines.en: scene sanatochika7
: That’s not offensive language, is it? “Low-income families?” Do you prefer “lower class” instead?
lines.zh: : 这说法不会冒犯吧？「低收入家庭」？还是你更喜欢「下层阶级」？

lines.en: : Definitely not. Low-income is both accurate and preferred over the latter. And thanks again for making this place affordable, Touka. It really means a lot to us.
lines.zh: : 绝对不是。低收入更准确，也比后者好听。再次感谢你给的机会。

lines.en: : You’re really okay with living here? I thought your place in the old district, like...held a lot of sentimental value and whatnot?
lines.zh: : 你真愿意住这儿？我还以为你老城区那个家……对你很有纪念意义什么的。

lines.en: scene sanatochika8
: It did. But staying there forever just...wasn’t going to be possible. Especially with the place practically falling apart over the last couple months.
lines.zh: : 以前是。但永远住在那儿……本来就不现实。尤其是那房子太旧了。

lines.en: : But, on the bright side, this place is so cheap that I can keep both of them. At least for a little while, I mean. Which is great since it gives Yumi a place to stay as well when she doesn’t want to be here.
lines.zh: : 不过往好处想，这地方便宜到我两边都能留着。至少暂时是。

lines.en: : Yumi? She’s staying at the old apartment?
lines.zh: : Yumi？她住旧公寓？

lines.en: scene sanatochika9
: Kinda? I actually think she likes the old district for whatever reason. And I’m pretty sure she’s trying to get a job at the convenience store since Noriko brought up an opening there to her.
lines.zh: : 算是吧？我觉得她不知怎么就挺喜欢老城区的。而且我敢肯定她不想搬。

lines.en: : So I think the plan now is for her to just bounce around and chip in for rent if she does get the job.
lines.zh: : 所以现在的打算是她来回两头跑，要是真找了工作就分摊点房租。

lines.en: scene sanatochika10
: But, of course none of this would be possible without you, Touka! You’re seriously saving my ass. And this place will be way better for Chinami in the long run.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，没有你可就没有这一切，Touka！你真是救了我一命。

lines.en: : Chinami liked her old house, but she likes this one a lot better! There’s hot water here! And Chinami loves hot water!
lines.zh: : Chinami 喜欢以前的家，但更喜欢这个家！这里有热水！电视也能用！

lines.en: : There’s no need to thank me, Chika. This is simply a business venture and not an act of charity by any means. And I will evict you if you do not make your payments on time.
lines.zh: : 不用谢我，Chika。这只是一桩生意，不是慈善。

lines.en: : Oh, you don’t have to worry about that. The maid cafe’s got me covered. And I’ve got auto-pay set up on the same day my new phone bill goes through, so I’ll always know when it’s coming!
lines.zh: : 哦，这个你不用担心。女仆咖啡厅养得起我。而且我设了自动付款。

lines.en: : Oh, right. I’m saving money now.
lines.zh: : 哦对。我现在开始攒钱了。

lines.en: scene sanatochika11
: You sure are! And with how cheap this place is, maybe you can get a room here as well.
lines.zh: : 可不是！这地方这么便宜，说不定你也能在这儿租一间。

lines.en: : This complex is for women only, I’m afraid. I apologize for the inconvenience, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 很遗憾，这栋公寓只住女性。给您带来不便还请见谅，Sensei。

lines.en: : Don’t worry. You’re still allowed to sleep over whenever you want. My name’s on the lease, so I get to do what I want.
lines.zh: : 别担心。你什么时候想来过夜都行。租约上签的是我的名字，所以没关系。

lines.en: : That much is true, yes. There are no rules in place prohibiting “sleepovers” of any sort. Just please keep the noise down as I’ve heard the two of you play games that tend to be rather...loud at times.
lines.zh: : 这倒是真的，没错。没有任何规定禁止任何形式的「过夜」。只要保持安静就行。

lines.en: scene sanatochika12
: Oh, you must be talking Yahtzee. I get really into...dice-based board games.
lines.zh: : 哦，你们肯定在说快艇骰子。我可喜欢……骰子类桌游了。

lines.en: : Yes...Yahtzee.
lines.zh: : 对……快艇骰子。

lines.en: scene sanatochika13
: Anyway, I must be leaving. I have other matters to attend to. Namely school, as I’m sure Miss Imai is currently wondering why my perfect attendance has suddenly become imperfect attendance.
lines.zh: : 那么，我先告辞了。我还有别的事要处理。比如上学，想必 Chosokabe 小姐清楚。

lines.en: : Touka...wait.
lines.zh: : Touka……等等。

lines.en: scene sanatochika14
: Wait?...
: Do you need something, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 您有事吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Yeah. What do you need from Touka? She’s a busy...business woman now. She’s got stuff to do and things to learn.
lines.zh: : 对啊。你找 Touka 有什么事？她现在可是个忙碌的……女商人了。她有事要忙什么的。

lines.en: : Can we...talk?
lines.zh: : 我们能……聊聊吗？

lines.en: : About what?
lines.zh: : 聊什么？

lines.en: : Uhh...
scene sanatochika15
: Ah. You must be referring to those business tips you inquired about before your two-month absence. I apologize, it’s just been so long that I must have forgotten.
lines.zh: : 啊。您一定是指您在消失两个月之前询问过的那些生意经。抱歉，隔了太久，我大概是忘了。

lines.en: : Business tips?
lines.zh: : 生意经？

lines.en: scene sanatochika16
: Is that correct, Sensei? Am I mistaken?
lines.zh: : 是这样吗，Sensei？是我会错意了吗？

lines.en: : Have you been thinking about quitting teaching for that long? What sort of business are you trying to get into?
lines.zh: : 你想转行不干老师这事想了那么久吗？你想做什么生意？

lines.en: : I...don’t know yet. Which is why I was looking for Touka’s help as I know she has experience with...business.
lines.zh: : 我……还没想好。所以我才找 Touka 帮忙，因为我知道她有……生意方面的经验。

lines.en: : Then, I will give you my business phone number. Which is not to be confused with my personal phone number. I am very wealthy, so the fact that I have two phone numbers is believable.
lines.zh: : 那么，我把我的工作电话给您。请别跟我的私人号码搞混了。我很有钱，所以我有两个手机号这件事很可信。

lines.en: : She’s got a point. That is believable.
lines.zh: : 她说得有道理。确实可信。

lines.en: : Your phone please, Sensei. I’ll enter my contact information that you may use to reach me during business hours only.
lines.zh: : 请把手机给我，Sensei。我把我的联系方式输进去，仅供您在工作时间使用。

lines.en: scene sanatochika17
Touka snatches my phone out of my hand and...all I can do is silently thank her inside of my head as she expertly covers for me in every which way possible.
lines.zh: Touka 从我手里一把拿过手机……我只能在心里默默感谢她，因为她用尽一切办法娴熟地替我打掩护。

lines.en: $ toukanumber = True
You have obtained Touka Tsukioka’s “business” phone number!
lines.zh: 你获得了 Touka Tsukioka 的「工作」电话号码！

lines.en: : Hey, isn’t that your personal number?
lines.zh: : 嘿，那不就是你的私人号码吗？

lines.en: Or not!
lines.zh: 才怪！

lines.en: : No. But they look very similar, so I can not fault you for thinking that.
lines.zh: : 不是。不过两个号码很像，所以你会认错也情有可原。

lines.en: : I can fault you for glaring at my belongings, though. That is very unbecoming of you, Chika.
lines.zh: : 不过你这么死盯着我的东西看，我可就得怪你了。这太不像话了，Chika。

lines.en: : Well, if you’re just gonna let them hang out like that-
lines.zh: : 那，你要是就让它那么晃在那儿——

lines.en: scene sanatochika18
: Really?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？

lines.en: : Oh. You meant your phone.
lines.zh: : 哦。你说的是你的手机。

lines.en: : What? They’re nice. We all know it.
lines.zh: : 干嘛？它们确实好看啊。大家都知道的。

lines.en: : Yes, well...
lines.zh: : 是，好吧……

lines.en: : Goodbye.
lines.zh: : 再见。

lines.en: scene sanatochika19
: You can look at mine if it makes you feel better!
lines.zh: : 你要想看，我的可以让你看！

lines.en: : I believe I will be fine without doing that, but thank you for the offer. Now again, goodbye.
lines.zh: : 我想我不看也没关系，不过谢谢你的好意。那么，再次告辞。

lines.en: : And Sensei, please do call about those business tips whenever you can. There are a few things I would like to ask you as well.
lines.zh: : 对了，Sensei，生意经的事您有空请务必打来。我也有几件事想请教您。

lines.en: : Yeah...see you.
lines.zh: : 嗯……回见。

lines.en: scene sanatochika20
Touka leaves and...honestly, I was not ready to see her today. But I guess I should have expected her to be here considering this is her building and all.
lines.zh: Touka 走了……说实话，我今天没做好见她的心理准备。不过考虑到这是她的楼，我早该料到她会在这儿。

lines.en: But...I need to focus on Chika for now. I’ve already messed things up with her after allowing Ami to walk all over her yesterday, so any chance I get to patch things up is-
lines.zh: 不过……现在我得先把心思放在 Chika 身上。昨天我放任 Ami 把她踩在脚下，已经把事情搞砸了，所以任何修补关系的机会都——

lines.en: : Okay. So. I don’t have much time before I have to leave for work, but I wanted you to see me in my outfit before I go since I heard from Uta how much you love maids.
lines.zh: : 好。那么。我上班前没剩多少时间了，但我想在走之前让你看看我这身打扮——因为我从 Uta 那儿听说你有多喜欢女仆。

lines.en: I guess patching things up can wait.
lines.zh: 看来修补关系可以等等再说。

lines.en: : I haven’t even commented on your hair yet, have I?
lines.zh: : 我还没来得及评价你的新发型呢，对吧？

lines.en: scene sanatochika21
: No, actually. I was so busy wanting to kill Ami yesterday that I forgot to ask you how you felt about it.
lines.zh: : 确实没有。我昨天光顾着想杀 Ami 了，都忘了问你喜不喜欢。

lines.en: : You look beautiful, Chika.
lines.zh: : 你看起来很美，Chika。

lines.en: scene sanatochika22
: Y...Yeah? You...really think so? It’s not weird after...seeing me blonde for so long?
lines.zh: : 真……真的？你……真这么觉得？看了我那么久的金发之后……不觉得怪吗？

lines.en: : Also, don’t look at the rest of me because I’m pretty sure I gained weight while you were gone. And I finally have enough money for a gym membership, but I haven’t had time to go yet and-
lines.zh: : 还有，别看我身上其他地方，因为你走的这段日子我多半胖了。我终于攒够了办健身卡的钱，可还没时间去——

lines.en: : Sorry to interrupt, but aren’t you short on time? I just really don’t want you to regret not showing me your costume, which is a thing I know you really want to do.
lines.zh: : 抱歉打断一下，你不是时间不多了吗？我只是不想让你因为没让我看你的制服而后悔——我知道你特别想给我看。

lines.en: : R...Right! Be right back!
lines.zh: : 对……对！我马上回来！

lines.en: scene black
scene sanatochika23
: What? Why are you looking at me like that?
lines.zh: : 干嘛？你为什么那样看着我？

lines.en: : Chinami knows flirting when she hears it. Exposure to cable television has made her more aware of love than ever before.
lines.zh: : Chinami 一听就知道是调情。有线电视让她对爱情比以往任何时候都更懂了。

lines.en: : Chinami, go back to watching TV. Your sister is-
lines.zh: : Chinami，回去看电视。你姐姐她——

lines.en: scene sanatochika24
: My sister really missed you.
lines.zh: : 我妹妹真的很想你。

lines.en: : Chinami will give you all the alone time you need together.
lines.zh: : Chinami 会留足你们俩单独相处的时间的。

lines.en: scene sanatochika25
: And if you just happen to give Chinami another sister, Chinami won’t mind.
lines.zh: : 而且要是你刚好再给 Chinami 添一个姐姐，Chinami 也不会介意。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m sure...
lines.zh: : 嗯，我想也是……

lines.en: : Okaaaaay! Here I coooooome!
scene sanatochika26
: Ta-da! Kumon-mi’s hottest new maid, at your service!
lines.zh: : 当当！Kumon-mi 最火辣的新晋女仆，为您服务！

lines.en: scene sanatochika27
: Oh! And speaking of which, did you know Niki was a maid once too?! I have no idea how I never heard about that! It must have been, like, a super underground early promo thing! But wow!
lines.zh: : 哦！说起来，你知道吗，Niki 以前也当过女仆？！我都不知道这事！肯定是那种超地下的早期宣传！不过哇！

lines.en: : Learning that was part of my orientation and just knowing I stood in the same locker room as her is...aaah! I’m so friggin’ pumped going to work every day now!
lines.zh: : 入职培训的时候听到了这个，光是想到我曾跟她站在同一间更衣室里就……啊！我现在每天去上班都超——级兴奋！

lines.en: Yeah, you’ve done much more than just “stand in the same locker room.”
lines.zh: 是啊，你可远不止「站在同一间更衣室」这么简单。

lines.en: : Like...what if she wore this same dress? Our bodies aren’t that different, right? She was probably a little smaller back when she did the promo, right? Right???
lines.zh: : 比如……她会不会穿过同款裙子？我们身材差别不大吧？她做宣传的时候可能更瘦一点，对吧？对吧？？？

lines.en: : Can I appreciate the way you look instead of thinking about her right now?
lines.zh: : 我现在能不能只欣赏你的样子，别想她了？

lines.en: : Yes! Please do!
lines.zh: : 好！请欣赏！

lines.en: : And please say a bunch of sweet things about me since I could really use the dopamine boost after the emotional rollercoaster that has been my last two months!
lines.zh: : 还有请多说点夸我的话，因为我这两个月坐了一趟情绪过山车，现在特别需要多巴胺！

lines.en: : You’re the second prettiest maid I’ve ever laid my eyes on.
lines.zh: : 你是我见过的第二漂亮的女仆。

lines.en: : That sucked! Hard! But I also knew it was coming since Uta told me all about your obsession with her!
lines.zh: : 好差劲！差评！不过我也料到了，因为 Uta 跟我说过你对她的痴迷！

lines.en: : My obsession is with Uta-chan, not Uta.
lines.zh: : 我痴迷的是 Uta 酱，不是 Uta。

lines.en: Though, I’d be lying if I said the two of them haven’t already merged together inside my head.
lines.zh: 不过，要说我脑子里还没把她俩融成一个人，那是假话。

lines.en: Chika doesn’t need to know that, though.
lines.zh: 不过 Chika 不需要知道这个。

lines.en: : Whatever! Say more nice things!
lines.zh: : 随便啦！再夸我点！

lines.en: : You’re adorable.
lines.zh: : 你很可爱。

lines.en: : More!
lines.zh: : 再来！

lines.en: : You’re...cute?
lines.zh: : 你很……漂亮？

lines.en: : More, more, more!
lines.zh: : 再来，再来，再来！

lines.en: : I love you.
lines.zh: : 我爱你。

lines.en: scene sanatochika28
: Kyah!
: Kyah?
: It’s just been so long since I’ve heard you say you love me that my heart skipped a beat! I feel like I’m ready to take on the world now!
lines.zh: : 我太久没听你说爱我了，刚才心都漏跳了一拍！我现在感觉自己能征服全世界了！

lines.en: : Then get out there and show the unnamed maid cafe what you’re made of.
lines.zh: : 那就出发吧，让那家没名字的女仆咖啡厅看看你的本事。

lines.en: : I’m sorry. I’ve never been good at making jokes to begin with, but making them when I feel like I could be crushed by the weight of the world at any given moment is significantly harder.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我本来就不擅长讲笑话，而当我随时觉得可能被全世界的重量压垮时，就更难讲出来了。

lines.en: : I’m just going to pretend you stopped saying things after “I love you” and go to work now!
lines.zh: : 我就当你说完「我爱你」就闭嘴了，我去上班啦！

lines.en: : Sounds good, Chika.
lines.zh: : 好啊，Chika。

lines.en: scene black
: Chinami! Be good for Sensei, okay?
lines.zh: : Chinami！乖乖听 Sensei 的话，知道吗？

lines.en: : Sensei, I love you too. Mwah!
lines.zh: : Sensei，我也爱你。么么！

lines.en: : LET’S FUCKING GOOOOO!
$ chikaspring2 = True
$ chika_love += 1
Chika’s affection has increased to [chika_love]!
lines.zh: Chika 的好感度提升到了 [chika_love]！

lines.en: jump chinamispring1
